protocol: FC6 frozen scoreboard, Bundesliga track (v1.5.0 beat-baseline)

derivation.method: Match metadata downloaded from StatsBomb open data; ID groups derived by running the repo split code (split_matches, pre_split_frames, match_group_split, transfer season filter) on stub frames carrying only match_id; counts cross-checked against runs/beat_baseline/results.json pool_counts and the run_beat_baseline.py docstring (130/32, 17/17).

code.transfer_filter: season_id + competition_id filter as in scripts/run_beat_baseline.py

known_non_disjoint_by_design.reason: extra_pool is era_pool plus Euro 2020 and ISL 2021/22 (subset by design).

Different arms: the transfer arm trains on 2015/16 Bundesliga pre-split matches and scores 2023/24; the main arm trains on the 130-group and scores held-out. Cross-arm overlap is not leakage because neither arm scores the other's training matches.
Same as above: pre-split 2015/16 matches falling in the main arm's held-out group are trained on only by the transfer bundle, which is never scored on held-out.

base_rate.definition: Constant prediction equal to the training-frame label mean, per label, estimated on training frames only; scored on the same matches as the model; no tuning on the scored half.

future_tracks.name: five_leagues
future_tracks.note: Separate Stage 3 FIXED-v2 track; its outputs never overwrite FC6 artifacts.

limitations: Per-match prediction rows are not stored in-repo: runs/beat_baseline/results.json carries per-match summaries only (mean/std/n/ci95). Per-match rows are recomputable with effc.vaep.calibration.per_match_scores on the frozen ID sets; they are not frozen here because they were computed in memory by the experiment driver.

Event-file bytes are not frozen in-repo (the full event corpus is gigabytes and gitignored). Match-metadata bytes are frozen by sha256 above; event content is bound at runtime by the vaep_cache_key content_digest mechanism (see effc.pipeline.compute_target_vaep) and by the improved-models cache key content_digest parameter.
Upstream StatsBomb open-data master is unpinned; a future upstream correction changes the metadata bytes and the audit detects it via the recorded digests.

Fitted model bundles are not stored in-repo (gitignored disk cache). Bundle identity is certified by the fingerprint derivation (config, seed, feature version, exact group/pool ID sets), recomputable from this manifest.
